noah: Who's up for low-effort weekend plans? Thinking: neighborhood cat rescue (long story) OR trying a rye sourdough starter experiment OR a quick paddle on the lake. Vote + one-line why.

alex: Paddle for me. Got a new inflatable kayak :canoe: — easy and outdoors.

maria: @noah I can help with the cat pickup, I have a carrier. Also planning to start a rye starter friday night, here's the recipe I like: https://tasty.example/rye-starter

jamal: Board game night Saturday? If we do the rescue earlier I'd join after.

sophie: I can bring kimchi pancakes for game night :drooling_face: — also down for kayak if wind's calm.

noah: Plan suggestion: cat pickup Sat 10am at my place -> try to find owner, otherwise drop at the shelter. Kayak Sunday AM (lazy float). Game night Sat 7pm at jamal's? Who can bring games?

alex: I'll bring Wingspan and a short Root setup. :thumbsup:

maria: I'll bring the spare carrier + towels. If anyone wants to follow the starter progress I'll post pics.

jamal: Quick FYI — got an automated notice from deploy-bot about minor infra maintenance Sun 14:00 UTC, shouldn't affect API but console might be flaky.

deploy-bot: REMINDER: Scheduled maintenance Sun 14:00-14:30 UTC. No customer-facing API disruptions expected.

sophie: OK vote tally (loose): cat rescue ✅, game night ✅, kayak ✅ (sunday). Also kimchi pancakes for game night = major plus.

noah: Sweet. I'll DM folks with details for the cat run. If anyone wants to carpool from downtown, say so here.

alex: I can do downtown pickup at 9:30.

maria: I'll meet you there at 9:45, thanks! :raised_hands:

jamal: count me in for games, bringing snacks.

sophie: See you all!
